basis_statement: Queue families partition dispatch law by durable worker concern so broker transport never degenerates into one giant truth-substituting queue.

queue_family_rows.ordering_basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one manifest and stage code.
queue_family_rows.dead_letter_posture: Replay only from durable workset or outbox truth after bounded retries.
notes: Competing consumers may scale horizontally only across distinct manifest stage order domains.
Stage packets point at persisted work definitions; they never carry large execution payloads inline.

queue_family_rows.ordering_basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one tenant, client, period, operation family, and frozen runtime scope.
queue_family_rows.dead_letter_posture: Dead-letter blocks live resend until persisted resend-legality and send-time revalidation truth permit it.
notes: Queue packets never infer resend legality; they carry the persisted legality state already decided by authority interaction truth.
Fresh authority mutation sends must fail closed when send-time revalidation detects lineage, token, or duplicate-bucket drift.

queue_family_rows.ordering_basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one authority interaction and duplicate-meaning bucket.
queue_family_rows.dead_letter_posture: Escalate to review when bounded read-only follow-up cannot resolve persisted ambiguity.
notes: Read-only follow-up remains distinct from outbound mutation sends even when it targets the same authority interaction lineage.
Dead-letter investigation must preserve canonical ingress receipt, interaction, and audit refs without replaying live queue history.

queue_family_rows.ordering_basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one manifest and projection family.
queue_family_rows.dead_letter_posture: Rebuild projections from persisted manifests, receipts, and audit truth rather than replaying queue memory.
notes: Projection queues remain disposable; rebuildability is a first-class requirement, not an operational afterthought.
Read-model refresh packets carry only snapshot refs, projection family refs, and integrity hashes.

queue_family_rows.ordering_basis_statement: Ordering is lawful only within one attempt lineage and recovery job class.
queue_family_rows.dead_letter_posture: Recovery jobs rebuild delivery fabric from durable checkpoints and never treat prior queue state as ground truth.
notes: Recovery job packets are coordination artifacts only; they point back to checkpoint and audit truth.
A recovery queue may rehydrate worker visibility, but it may not authorize fresh legal mutation by itself.
